data.title: Daniel-Kofi Kyereh Returns to Ghana Squad for Somalia Qualifiers - Telecom Asia Sport
data.content: # Daniel-Kofi Kyereh Returns to Ghana Squad for Somalia Qualifiers. **Daniel-Kofi Kyereh has earned a Ghana recall for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying double-header against Somalia after a prolonged injury absence, GHANAsoccernet reports.**. The 30-year-old attacking midfielder last represented Ghana in December 2022, having made 18 senior appearances for the Black Stars. Ghana will host Somalia at Essipong Sports Stadium in Sekondi on November 12, with kick-off scheduled for 15:00 GMT. The return qualifier is set for the same stadium on November 16 at 15:00 GMT, with Somalia designated as the home team because it does not have a CAF-approved venue.
